tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Pointwise normal and strongly convex balls] ↗ def:exponential-map ↗ def:geodesic

For every $p\in M$ there is a positive radius on whose model-space ball the exponential map is defined and injective, with open image. There is also $\beta >0$ such that the closed metric ball $\overline B(p,\beta )$ is strongly convex: every two of its points are joined by a unique minimizing geodesic whose open arc stays in the ball.
